scenes.title: Знакомство с байкером  (Meeting the Biker)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov chats warmly with a biker nicknamed Piston about motorcycles until Katya walks out and introduces Barinov as her father.

scenes.title: Опоздание и спор у входа  (Late Arrival and an Argument Outside)
scenes.summary: Lyova orders Max to take out the trash all day for calling the Chef a walrus, and outside Max argues with an aggressive driver blocking the path.

scenes.title: Удар в живот и запрет Шефа  (A Punch to the Stomach and the Chef's Ban)
scenes.summary: The driver intimidates Max outside, and inside the kitchen Chef Barinov angrily forbids Katya from dating Stas while Katya defends her boyfriend.

scenes.title: Икота и седьмой столик  (Hiccups and Table Seven)
scenes.summary: Senya tries to cure Max's hiccups by pounding his back and telling him to hold his breath, and Kostya tells Max that Table Seven is calling for him.

scenes.title: Вызов на разговор и взятка  (Summoned for a Talk and a Bribe)
scenes.summary: Max stalls the angry guests at Table Seven by saying he has to finish stuffing a dish, while Chef Barinov meets Stas and pays him 100,000 rubles to break up with Katya.

scenes.title: Катя возвращает деньги  (Katya Returns the Money)
scenes.summary: Max fakes dizziness so Lyova will let him go home early, and Katya furiously returns the bribe money to her father after Stas tells her everything.

scenes.title: Совет Тимура  (Timur's Advice)
scenes.summary: Stas demands 300,000 rubles from Chef Barinov, and Max calls Timur, who advises him to set a generous table with good meat and wine to make peace.

scenes.title: Свинина и разговор во дворе  (Pork and a Talk in the Courtyard)
scenes.summary: Max accidentally serves pork to the guests at Table Seven, and in the courtyard Chef Barinov confronts Stas before Katya catches her father attacking him.

scenes.title: Бейсбол во дворе  (Baseball in the Courtyard)
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya pretend they were just going to play baseball, Katya leaves angrily with Stas, and Senya tells Max to solve his own problems.

scenes.title: Тимур идёт на переговоры  (Timur Goes to Negotiate)
scenes.summary: Timur agrees to talk to the angry men in the courtyard in exchange for Max overlooking slightly old shrimp, and Chef Barinov invites Katya and Stas to the restaurant.

scenes.title: Свинина всё меняет  (The Pork Changes Everything)
scenes.summary: Timur happily tells Max he arranged a meat supply deal with the men, but says Max's situation is worse because Max didn't tell him about serving them pork.

scenes.title: Французский метод от икоты  (The French Method for Hiccups)
scenes.summary: Max stalls Timur again, Louis suggests curing Max's hiccups by giving him a strong fright, and Stas arrives at the restaurant with several biker friends.

scenes.title: Ложная скорая и байкеры в зале  (Fake Ambulance and Bikers in the Hall)
scenes.summary: Max calls an ambulance faking appendicitis, Timur drags him toward the exit to keep his word, and Katya tells her father that Stas brought bikers fearing an ambush.

scenes.title: Лёва перестал заикаться  (Lyova Stopped Stuttering)
scenes.summary: Louis and Fedya's scare prank hits Lyova by mistake, curing his stutter on the spot, while Chef Barinov walks out to greet Katya and Stas.

scenes.title: Благословение Шефа и торг  (The Chef's Blessing and Haggling)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov pretends to bless Katya and Stas's relationship, prompting a panicked Stas to drop his buyout demand from 500,000 back down to 100,000 rubles.

scenes.title: Слухи о засаде  (Rumors of an Ambush)
scenes.summary: Katya hears about the tough men in the back courtyard and assumes her father called them to ambush Stas, while Barinov pays Stas in his office.

scenes.title: Две компании во дворе  (Two Gangs in the Courtyard)
scenes.summary: Max tries to stop the bikers from going outside and starting a fight, while Katya bursts into the office accusing her father of hiring thugs.

scenes.title: Перемирие и новая ссора  (A Truce and a New Quarrel)
scenes.summary: The guests think the bikers are Max's friends and offer a peaceful truce, until the bikers admit they are seeing Max for the first time, just as Chef Barinov storms out.

scenes.title: Ярость Шефа спасает Макса  (The Chef's Fury Saves Max)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov storms out with a cleaver screaming about nutmeg in the sauce, which scares away all the tough guys, and Stas tells Katya they need to break up.

scenes.title: Кто подставит плечо  (Who Will Lend a Shoulder)
scenes.summary: Katya discovers her father and Stas were bargaining over her, rides away on Stas's motorcycle knocking Chef Barinov down, and Max's hiccups finally stop when the ambulance arrives.
